Elegant corner villa in the sought-after Nakheel Villas community, offering a perfect blend of space, privacy, and comfort. This beautifully designed 3-bedroom home with a maid’s room features a generous layout ideal for family living, complemented by bright interiors and excellent outdoor space.
The villa sits on a spacious 3,413 sq. ft. plot, providing ample room for both indoor and outdoor enjoyment. Being a corner unit, it offers enhanced privacy and a larger private garden area, perfect for relaxing, entertaining, or family gatherings.
